Package org.h2.engine

Class Right

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.h2.engine.DbObject
      • org.h2.engine.Right
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.h2.util.HasSQL
    public final class Right
extends DbObject
    An access right. Rights are regular database objects, but have generated names.
